source_model: No pretrained PPO / no learned model; scripted native Panda and xArm6 control
controller: pd_ee_target_delta_pose; root-left Panda and xArm6 native full joint/gripper ABI different
inference_signal: public end-effector position delta [actual achieved XYZ at end of t3 zero native arm probe MINUS end of t1 pose], never private target state
candidate_training: On independent earlier physical calibration seeds, pair both actually applied/held native robot simulations, record public pose delta, take per-truth mean, maximum L2 residual to the mean, add prespecified margin 0.002m to each. No tuning on new test labels.
classification: For NEW seeded robot and two separately real-PhysX executed truths, feed each single observed post-probe pose delta to the robot's calibrated two envelopes; choose class only if contained in exactly ONE envelope. Otherwise REFUSE and abstain. No shared input between physically realized twin worlds in classifier.

primary_gate.confidence_claim: empirical support region not a certified lower bound on error

measurements: per-test robot, seed, true delivery only for post-decision scorer
false authorization even if task flag success
test 32-case coverage and false labels conditional on authorization
preprobe and postprobe achieved position and physical displacement
original native private target getter used ONLY in after-physics audit
robot native controller keys and actual morphology
limits: scripted actions: NOT frozen trained PPO transfer to xArm6
no collision/contact/actuator safety; not independent outside lab
known Panda chart, same framework ManiSkill, no unknown interface semantics
calibration models incorporate truth-labeled prior PhysX states and therefore are not model-free
constant scripted command family; not varied unknown fault sizes, task policies, sensors or network delay
prior 8 calibration seed results were inspected; new held-out seeds preregistered before method implementation; model hyperparameters are fixed in this protocol
